title: Catalogue the skip link (class .skip) as a component

review.applied: status -> beta (lifecycle honesty: no behavioural coverage yet); docs-map pinned to /components/navigation; version-regen mechanics recorded; evidence number fixed (13.0 = 8.0 tokens + 5.0 '~navigation link' phrase bonus, both packs); margin-clog transition accepted as recorded ('a link that jumps past the navigation' -> UNDEFINED, safer than the false RESOLVED); scratch evidence rebuilt from snapshot+curation

problem: Agents asking for a skip link get a false RESOLVED to component/nav-item: nav-item's multi-word alias "navigation link" fires a phrase bonus on any query containing "navigation" and "link". The .skip class itself is shipped and documented in three places (core/base.css, css-catalog.md, components.md, and the site's Shell contract card) but no pack catalogues it, so the honest answer cannot be cited.
evidence: dispute/20261008-134355-5a90bd: "a skip link to jump past the navigation" -> component/nav-item at 13.0 (8.0 tokens + 5.0 '~navigation link' phrase bonus) on both pinned and evolution
gap/20261008-124813-ac670b (Duty build): agent used the shipped .skip class, refused nav-item, filed the gap
core/base.css:19 .skip + :30 .skip:focus (hidden until focused, jumps to #main) in both snapshots
provenance/references/css-catalog.md: "`.skip` - skip-link"; components.md: "".skip" link first in body"
scratch pre-test: with the record present, the query -> RESOLVED component/skip; nav queries unchanged (docs/evolution/data/r2-scratch)
existing_authority_considered: component/nav-item - wrong owner; the skip link is a page-level shortcut, not a nav item
deleting nav-item's "navigation link" alias - rejected: legitimate nav vocabulary; risks regressing honest nav queries
fallback/no-js etc. - fallbacks are for implementable defaults; the class exists, only addressability is missing
why_insufficient: The visual and behavioural layer already exists and is used in every page template; what is missing is a citable catalogue entry with aliases so resolution can answer honestly instead of mis-claiming nav-item.

triage_snapshot: spec/states.json: add component {class: "skip", name: "Skip link", source: "base.css", status: "beta", states: ["default", "focus"], verify: [".skip", ".skip:focus"], a11y: ["first element in body; hidden until focused; focus moves it into view; targets #main"]}
VERSION + package.json + spec/rules.json + spec/states.json(version) + rename-map.json -> 0.13.1-experiment; CHANGELOG entry
no rule changes; the class already ships; generated banners regenerate with the version (build.py core, build.py tokens, tools/build_icons.py)
curation: aliases.json: component/skip -> ["skip link", "skip to content", "skip navigation", "jump to content"]
component-notes.json: component/skip -> "Skip link: first in body; hidden until focused, jumps to #main. Keeps keyboard users out of the nav."

not_proposed: removing or rephrasing component/nav-item aliases (rejected above)
a new CSS utility or any visual change
compatibility: Additive only: a new catalogue entry for an existing shipped class. No selector semantics altered.

validation.criterion: achievable contract under the frozen kernel:
validation.mapping: VERIFIED: "a skip link to jump past the navigation" -> RESOLVED component/skip 26.0 (margin 13.0); "skip to content" searches hit component/skip; nav non-regression unchanged ("a navigation link in the sidebar" 22.0, "a sidebar link with an active state" 16.0)
validation.triage_gates: VERIFIED: build.py check 69 tests OK; tools/verify.py all-green incl. 38 components selector-by-selector; browser suite 248/248 across 10 fixtures with 30 baseline captures and zero UI-baseline drift
validation.non_regression: "a navigation link in the sidebar", "a sidebar link with an active state" -> component/nav-item unchanged; two adjacent nav phrasings move false-RESOLVED -> UNDEFINED (margin-clog; accepted, do not chase); full battery in docs/evolution/data/round2/

migration: None for consumers: the class is unchanged. Existing implementations keeping a bare .skip remain conformant; new work can cite component/skip.
